flora: Giant Araucaria tree (tall, geometric branches with scale-like leaves, dominating the skyline)
Cycads (short, thick armored trunks with stiff, radiating fronds in the midground)
A golden Ginkgo tree (adding a splash of yellow-green)
Tall Tree Ferns and Horsetail stands near a small stream
Lush Herbaceous Fern carpet and soft Moss covering the foreground rocks
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile textures; very high visual density; clear educational silhouettes for each plant type.

visual_logic.composition: A rich, multi-layered landscape. The massive Araucaria and Ginkgo anchor the background. Cycads and Tree Ferns fill the mid-ground. The foreground is a soft bed of moss and ferns. Centered at the bottom or top is the text 'Dino Flora!' in bright red, 3D mixed-case letters with a slight bevel.
visual_logic.ground: A mix of damp earth, mossy stones, and a tiny bit of shoreline for the horsetails.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, cinematic golden-hour light that makes the red text 'pop' and highlights the textures of the various leaves.
